comment: Notice places (mitcad#1327), tools/ui-notice-places-test.sh: a block 60 x 40 x 20 (Body1 F1.b0), its top front edge rounded 1 (Front, F2), a hole of 10 (F3) whose top rim lies 0.1 mm from that rounding, the rim rounded 1 (Rim, F4): the kernel's rounding stops at the front rounding, the ring built instead runs 0.9 mm onto it and leaves an edge there (about 53 degrees), a warning whose places are the rim's rounding, the front rounding, the edge and a point.
